/usr/local/bin/bash -lc if [ -z "$BASH_ENV" ] && [ -r "$HOME/.bashrc" ]; then\012  . "$HOME/.bashrc"\012fi\012echo '# Snapshot file'\012echo '# Unset all aliases to avoid conflicts with functions'\012unalias -a 2>/dev/null || true\012echo '# Functions'\012declare -f\012echo ''\012bash_opts=$(set -o | awk '$2=="on"{print $1}')\012bash_opt_count=$(printf '%s
' "$bash_opts" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')\012echo "# setopts $bash_opt_count"\012if [ -n "$bash_opts" ]; then\012  printf 'set -o %s
' $bash_opts\012fi\012echo ''\012alias_count=$(alias -p | wc -l | tr -d ' ')\012echo "# aliases $alias_count"\012alias -p\012echo ''\012# Capture exported variables\012export_lines=$(\012  while IFS= read -r name; do\012    if [[ "$name" =~ ^(PWD|OLDPWD)$ ]]; then\012      continue\012    fi\012    if [[ ! "$name" =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ ]]; then\012      continue\012    fi\012    declare -xp "$name" 2>/dev/null || true\012  done < <(compgen -e)\012)\012export_count=$(printf '%s
' "$export_lines" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')\012echo "# exports $export_count"\012if [ -n "$export_lines" ]; then\012  printf '%s
' "$export_lines"\012fi\012
